metaTitle: Custom Yoga Gift Boxes & Ribbons | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom yoga gift boxes and ribbons for your studio or event. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Yoga studios and wellness events need gift packaging that reflects calm and mindfulness. Custom yoga gift boxes and ribbons let you coordinate ribbons with box colors or add studio logos to satin ribbons. Choose dye-sublimated ribbons for full-color branding on 5/8" or 1 1/2" widths, or classic 7/8" full-color ribbon for a polished finish. These components are ideal for welcome kits, teacher appreciation gifts, or retail packaging that extends your brand beyond the mat.
heroAltText: Custom yoga gift boxes and ribbons with studio logo on satin ribbon
